semantic_findings: Per-class unique VM class ID implements the original private brand without a public symbol or prototype test. Proxy/revoked/forged receivers are rejected without traps. New-target receiver/prototype allocation precedes genuine WeakRef construction.

Each charged native instance owns the actual captured WeakRef wrapper and optional strong root. GC marking traces those two JS roots but does not strongly mark the weak target itself. The finalizer clears opaque and fields before freeing roots and returning the aggregate charge.

The counter uses f64 Number arithmetic, preserves negative counts and binary64 rounding, and strengthens only at exact transition to one. Exact zero clears the strong slot before retirement. Return reads the current counter after potentially reentrant retirement.

Every get invokes the genuine captured WeakRef.deref even when a strong root exists, preserving actual kept-object behavior. Constructor/deref VM rules, current-stack guard and explicit finishJob boundaries support the controls without a fake weak store.

Pending entry/callback errors win before mutation. Receiver and newly constructed instance remain rooted through calls and retirement. Required intrinsic unwrapping precedes allocation; no default or optional fallback is invented.

The retirement control explicitly performs collection before observing its finalizer probe, so it does not assume immediate DECREF. The charged allocation control is consistent with the 32 inline Scope roots and reaches the intended Instance allocation.
